description: Query live DeFiLlama yield pools across Base, Arbitrum, Solana, Ethereum, Optimism, Polygon, and BSC ranked by risk-adjusted sustainable APY and TVL safety score. Read-only market scan (5 free calls/hour per IP returning top 3 pools; full top-25 available via X-API-Key or $0.02 USDC x402 API). Returns JSON with `count`, `chain_filter`, `asset_filter`, and `pools` array (`project`, `symbol`, `chain`, `apy_total`, `apy_base`, `tvl_usd`, `safety_score`, `il_risk`).

asset.description: Token symbol substring filter (e.g. `USDC`, `USDT`, `ETH`, `SOL`, or empty string for any asset). Defaults to `USDC`.

min_tvl_usd.description: Minimum pool Total Value Locked (TVL) in USD required for inclusion. Defaults to `1000000` ($1M).

no_il_only.description: When `true` (default), restricts results to single-sided lending/staking or correlated pools with zero impermanent loss risk.

name: find_best_defi_yields
